description: This file defines the 'ScreenPermission' entity class using Doctrine ORM annotations. It models access permissions for user roles on specific screens in the OrangeHRM system, including properties for read, create, update, and delete permissions, as well as relationships to UserRole and Screen entities.

classes.name: ScreenPermission
classes.description: Entity class representing permission settings for a specific user role on a particular screen, including flags for read, create, update, delete permissions, and relationships to UserRole and Screen entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this permission record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this permission record.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether delete permission is granted.

methods.name: setUserRole
methods.description: Associates a UserRole entity with this permission.

methods.name: setScreen
methods.description: Associates a Screen entity with this permission.
